villager_manners.settings.title: Villager Manners Settings
villager_manners.settings.section: Villagers Stand Beside, Not on Top
villager_manners.settings.workstations.t: Keeps Villagers from standing on Workstations. They work from beside them instead.
villager_manners.settings.beds.tooltip: Keeps Villagers from standing on Beds. They still sleep in them.
villager_manners.settings.children_jump_: Lets Baby Villagers keep jumping on Beds. Requires Beds to be on.
villager_manners.settings.player_beds.to: Villagers don't claim or sleep in a Bed that an online Player has set as their spawn point.
villager_manners.settings.bells.tooltip: Keeps Villagers from standing on Bells.
villager_manners.settings.chests.tooltip: Keeps Villagers from standing on Chests, Trapped Chests, Ender Chests and Copper Chests.
villager_manners.settings.crafting_table: Keeps Villagers from standing on Crafting Tables and Furnaces.
villager_manners.settings.other_furnitur: Anvils, Enchanting Tables, Decorated Pots, Jukeboxes
Keeps Villagers from standing on Anvils, Enchanting Tables, Decorated Pots and Jukeboxes.
villager_manners.settings.stairs.tooltip: Keeps Villagers from standing on Stairs, like the chairs in village houses. They still use Stairs to get around.
villager_manners.settings.pressure_plate: Keeps Villagers from standing on Pressure Plates, like the ones on village tables.
villager_manners.settings.trapdoors.tool: Keeps Villagers from walking through open Trapdoors, so they find another way around.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.villager_mann: Villagers stand beside their workstations, beds and furniture, not on top.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.villager_: Villagers don't stand on top of workstations, beds, bell and furniture like chests and crafting tables.
